content:
peter_sre: Heads-up: Planned staged failover + SLO rollback drill on Mon 2026-05-10 04:00-05:00 UTC. Purpose: validate automated AZ failover, fast rollback, and customer notification flow. Affects control-plane routing and edge inference in us-west-2 and eu-west-1.
peter_sre: TL;DR flow: start canary failover (5%) -> observe 12m -> ramp to 30% -> trigger short SLO dwell to force rollback path -> validate automatic rollback and fallback-model routing.
opsbot: Event created: "az-failover-rollback-drill" 2026-05-10T04:00Z (ops link: https://ops.internal/events/AFR-2026-05-10).
alexa_oncall: Ack. I'll be oncall and watching metrics: infer.p95, route.5xx_rate, route.fallback_rate, routing.preemptions.
maria_prod: Product: Prepare support blurb for Dedicated tenants if we exceed p95 +10% for >20m. Support contact: support@redwood-inference.
tony_eng: Question: which flags are we flipping to shorten SLO dwell?
peter_sre: We'll set `slo.rollback.dwell=600s` and `routing.preemption.fast=true` during the drill. Commands: `infractl config set slo.rollback.dwell=600` and `infractl config set routing.preemption.fast=true`.
infra_bot: Config queued: failover-drill-flags@infra at 2026-05-10T03:55Z by peter_sre.
alexa_oncall: Runbook short ops: 1) start canary: `infractl failover start --az eu-west-1b --percent 5 --mode canary` 2) observe 12m 3) ramp: `infractl failover ramp --percent 30 --stages 5,15,30` 4) if infer.p95 > baseline*1.15 for 10m OR 5xx > 0.4% -> abort: `infractl failover abort --az eu-west-1b` and revert flags.
ton y_eng: I'll run synthetic traffic against heavy-token routes to exercise preemption. Will cap at 150 qps per AZ and add jitter.
peter_sre: Escalation: if Dedicated tenant impacted, include tenant id, affected routes, observed p95 and ETA in the support note. We'll only send customer notice if threshold breached.
alexa_oncall: I'll post status updates here at start, +12m, and on completion. Anyone want to shadow the canary? Ping before 03:45 UTC. :thumbsup:
